meta.title: UCF WordPress Block Theme
meta.description: The theme on its basic-blocks branch, with the UCF University Header (injected by the theme) and the UCF Footer plugin, plus a homepage, a degree program page and a research story built from the theme's patterns, and a style guide page with every block and pattern.
meta.author: UCF

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// Pages built from the theme's own page patterns, so the demo always matches the branch.
function ucf_playground_page( $title, $slug, $pattern, $type = 'page', $template = 'page-landing' ) {
	$id = wp_insert_post(
		array(
			'post_type'    => $type,
			'post_status'  => 'publish',
			'post_title'   => $title,
			'post_name'    => $slug,
			'post_excerpt' => 'post' === $type ? 'A UCF team makes the dust that seals, bearings and optics meet on the Moon, so they fail in a Florida lab instead.' : '',
			'post_content' => '<!-- wp:pattern {"slug":"ucf-wordpress-block-theme/' . $pattern . '"} /-->',
		)
	);
	if ( $template && 'page' === $type ) {
		update_post_meta( $id, '_wp_page_template', $template );
	}
	return $id;
}

$home = ucf_playground_page( 'University of Central Florida', 'home', 'page-home' );
ucf_playground_page( 'Computer Science B.S.', 'computer-science-bs', 'page-degree-program' );
ucf_playground_page( 'A lunar dust simulant built to break hardware early', 'lunar-dust-simulant', 'post-research-story', 'post', '' );

update_option( 'show_on_front', 'page' );
update_option( 'page_on_front', $home );

<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// The style guide page: every block and pattern. Built by the theme's own script, when the
// installed branch has it, so the page matches the theme it ships with.
$ucf_theme_style_guide = get_theme_file_path( 'tools/style-guide.php' );
if ( file_exists( $ucf_theme_style_guide ) ) {
	define( 'UCF_THEME_STYLE_GUIDE', true );
	require $ucf_theme_style_guide;
}
